description: This file defines the Attribute class which models product attributes in the web shop, including properties like name, type, code, and associated attribute values.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a product attribute with properties such as name, type, code, and values, extending ShopEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the attribute.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the attribute.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the attribute.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the list of attribute values.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Sets the list of attribute values.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier of the attribute.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier of the attribute.
